message.p: Set the tactics for your next match on this page.
Both the formation and the value under "Play attacking football" determine how offensively, and therefore how riskily, you want to play. Adjust this according to your opponent.

You can drag players onto the pitch with your mouse. Alternatively, press the corresponding buttons or double-click the row of the player you want. Double-clicking only works if the player has a main position and that position is not yet occupied.
Place up to five players on the bench by clicking the bench icon next to a player. This allows substitutions during the match, for example because of injuries or for tactical reasons.
Train your team regularly to improve the players' stamina, technique or freshness.
How to train your team:

ul.li: Select a coach and hire him for a number of training sessions of your choice.
Once you have hired a coach, you can set the intensity and training focus.
Press the "Run training" button. The players will immediately train under the coach's supervision according to your settings.

message.p: You cannot run training while a match is in progress.
The "Effectiveness" value indicates how successfully the coach trains. For example, 50% means that a player has a 50% chance of improving during a training session.
Please note that the coach's fee is deducted from your club account immediately when he is hired.

When you run a training session, players improve according to the coach's effectiveness and the selected intensity. The higher the intensity, the more freshness the players lose during training, but the greater the chance that their technique or stamina will improve.
Injured players do not take part in training and recover instead. They therefore gain freshness.
Select a sponsor who pays you a bonus for every competitive match.

The sponsors available to you depend on your sporting success. You can wait before signing a contract if you believe you will win the next matches and may therefore receive an even better sponsor offer. Alternatively, choose a sponsor earlier to receive bonus payments immediately or if you fear that you may drop down the league table.
A valid sponsorship contract cannot be terminated early.
Set the ticket prices for your home matches here. To help you choose suitable prices, the attendance at your last home match is displayed.
Attendance depends on:

ul.li: The ticket prices. They should not be significantly higher than the league average (initial values).
Your fan popularity, which depends on your sporting success.
The attractiveness of the home match. For example, if you play against a team close to you in the table, you may be able to raise prices slightly. You should lower them again afterwards.

message.p: This page shows the size and layout of your stadium.
The grey area above the seats indicates the maximum size to which your stadium could theoretically be expanded.

In the form below the graphic, you can specify how many new places you want to add. After submitting the form, construction companies will provide price quotes and completion dates. Once you select a suitable offer, the total cost is deducted from your account immediately and construction begins.
A stadium expansion must be confirmed manually after the construction period ends! Please note that very inexpensive construction companies may occasionally misjudge the planned construction time.
Reducing the stadium's capacity is not possible.
Here you can see an overview of all players currently under contract with your team. Visit this page regularly to avoid unintentionally losing players whose contracts expire.

You can sell players at any time by pressing the "Sell" button next to the relevant player and then setting a minimum bid. The player is placed on the transfer market, where other users can bid for him. Until he is actually sold to the highest bidder, the player remains in your team.
Please note that you cannot remove a player from the transfer market afterwards.

Players whose contracts are due to expire soon and can be extended are marked in red with an exclamation mark in the overview. A "Contract extension" button also appears. Clicking it takes you to the contract extension negotiations.
If you do not extend a contract, the player is automatically removed from your team when it expires and offered on the transfer market as a free agent.
A captain can boost morale when your team falls behind. The more experienced the player, the more respect he commands within the team.
Be careful when changing captain. Your previous captain may resent the decision.
If there is a break without matches, you can send your team to a training camp.
You do not need to hire a coach for this, as the training camp provides one who is guaranteed to improve or reduce your players' values each day by the amounts shown on the page.
The cost of the training camp is deducted from your club account immediately when it is booked.
Only one training camp can be booked at a time. You can reserve another date only after the team returns from camp.
Sign new players through the transfer market or check whether anyone has bid for your own players.

Only players available on the transfer market can be signed. Players are sold by auction, even when offered as free agents. For free agents, the highest salary offer, including any signing-on fee, is decisive. For transfers between clubs, the highest transfer fee wins.
To bid for a player, or simply to view information about the current highest bid, click either the current transfer fee or the "Bid" button.
Please note that the number of permitted transactions between the same users is limited. You should therefore avoid bidding for several players from the same club.
You can place your own players on the transfer market by opening "My Team" and making players available for sale there.
Bid for the selected player here or simply monitor whether new highest bids have been submitted.

p.strong: Bidding for a player from another club

message.p: The amount of the transfer fee offered is decisive. The salary merely needs to satisfy the player and does not have to be better than the current highest bid.
You must make the most attractive salary offer for the player. The player automatically chooses the club where he can earn the most overall. A goal bonus is irrelevant to defenders and goalkeepers.
A "signing-on fee" is an amount paid to the player when he joins, regardless of the contract length.
Send short messages to other users here.
For security reasons, you must know the recipient's username. Copy it into the "Recipient" field, or type the first two or three letters and wait for the system to suggest the full username.
Please note that advertising is prohibited and a short waiting period is applied between messages to prevent abuse.
Also note that messages are stored unencrypted in the database. Do not send confidential information.
HTML is not allowed.
